notes.title: 🚀 Tales of Ancients: The Forgotten Path Joins Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091061/151743b4dc6f589854d868aaf24be7dd84fccbd1.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3535490/Tales_of_Ancients__The_Forgotten_Path/


🔥 [i]Tales of Ancients: The Forgotten Path[/i] is [b]a standalone story[/b] set in the eerie universe of Tales of Ancients. It’s a [b]separate experience[/b], offering a fresh perspective on Lynxvale’s unsettling past.


🕵️‍♂️ [b]This is not the main game.[/b] This is a unique, self-contained journey designed to expand the world and introduce new mysteries. Whether you're new to Tales of Ancients or a returning traveler, this is a different story waiting to be uncovered.


💡 [b]Your feedback matters![/b] This experience is still evolving, and we want players like you to help shape its direction. Your thoughts, discoveries, and insights will guide its future development.


🎮 [b]Join Steam Next Fest, play the demo, and share your feedback[/b]. Your journey starts now—how will you shape The Forgotten Path?

notes.title: Tales of Ancients: The Forgotten Path Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091061/1df4c18f4986432a39b9ae5db4b1cf58385b48f8.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3535490/Tales_of_Ancients__The_Forgotten_Path/

🔮 Tales of Ancients: The Forgotten Path is a standalone demo set within the Tales of Ancients universe. While it exists in the same eerie world, it offers a different perspective—an experience separate from the main story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091061/380c2f59fd83b1f625b85bf234529c21160a96fd.png[/img]

👁️ Explore the forgotten echoes of Lynxvale, where long-buried secrets linger beneath the surface. Step into the unknown, uncover unsettling truths, and face the enigmatic presence that lurks in the shadows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091061/1233f25d12fd4bf6b58b5d9bef813ef583958ba7.png[/img]

⚠️ This is not the beginning of the full journey—but a glimpse into what lies beyond the veil. Will you dare to enter?

🕯️ Download the demo now and step into the unknown.

🌍 Please note: The demo is available in English only, but the full game will support multiple languages upon release.
